definitions.explanation: Waste that can be incinerated, such as food scraps, paper, and certain plastics. One of the main garbage categories in Japanese waste separation.

examples.japanese: {可燃|かねん}ごみ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{火曜日|かようび}→火曜日：00640_kayoubi⟧です。
⟦{生|なま}ゴミ→生ゴミ：08044_namagomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{可燃|かねん}ごみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Put food waste in burnable garbage.

examples.japanese: {可燃|かねん}ごみ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put burnable garbage in the designated bags.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {可燃|かねん}ごみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to put out burnable garbage
- {可燃|かねん}ごみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: burnable garbage day
- ⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧{袋|ぶくろ}: designated garbage bag

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has strict garbage separation rules that vary by municipality. Burnable garbage typically includes kitchen waste, paper, and some plastics.

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{資源|しげん}ごみ→資源ごみ：09537_shigengomi⟧: recyclable waste
